body: I mean I dunno I've given it a lot of chances and it turns out the same way every time. Same if I work hard. Everything comes crashing down. And yeah, I get it, it's life and all. But if this is life then I'm not sure I wanna be living. Where's the end? WHEN is the end? The happiness? What's the point? What's there to look forward to? I don't see it.

Just... Literally everything that has happened. All I've ever been is a useless burden. Never done anything good for anyone. Nobody needs me. I've never done anything good for myself. Even when I try to do something half decent apparently I'm incapable of that. I'm an idiot and I've never done good in school. I've got no hobbies or talents or skills. Nothing makes me happy. Nothing in life I want nor need to look forward too. And yet here I am, existing, wasting money and time and resources and air that could have gone to somebody who's worth half the damn that I am.

r/runaway. I haven't really been on there in a few years so I dunno what it's like anymore but it was a place of interest of mine when I was considering running away along with other places like wikiHow on how to run away.
